_meta.title: Dub video: transcribe (Whisper)
_meta.description: Step 1 of the Dub video tool. LoadAudio reads the audio track directly from the uploaded clip, so no video frames are decoded. TrimAudioDuration keeps only the span being dubbed: up to 14.76 s in lipsync mode, up to 30 s in audio-only mode. CJWhisperASR (comfy_nodes/cj_whisper_asr) transcribes it offline with the local whisper-large-v3-turbo model. Two PreviewAny nodes return the plain transcript and a JSON array of timed segments as text outputs. Builder: src/lib/oj/dubVideo.ts.
